_schema.purpose: Single source of truth for every URL the research agent is allowed to fetch. Skill loads this and passes via idea_context.sourcesWhitelist; agent uses it for trusted_sources_only=true enforcement, Phase 0 lineup discovery, Phase 1+2+3 mining, and per-model fallback. Tier weights drive trustScore (I=1.0, S=0.7, C=0.4, U=never-written).

structure.vendors: Per-vendor URL bundles. tier='S' (vendor self-report). Used by both Phase 0 lineup discovery (urls.lineup) and per-model S-tier fallback (urls.news/docs/pricing).
structure.leaderboards: Independent benchmark sources. tier='I'. Used by Phase 1 mining.
structure.aggregators: Multi-provider inference catalogs. tier='I'. Used by Phase 2 multi-provider pricing mining.
structure.local: Local-runtime catalogs (Ollama, Unsloth, quants). tier='I'. Used per-model when tier='ollama' or vramRequirement is sought.
structure.registries: Model metadata registries (HF leaderboard, llmfit). tier='I'.
structure.community: Aggregator blogs / expert commentary. tier='C'. Used only when no I/S source carries the value.
structure.complianceAggregators: Vendor-agnostic compliance/audit registries. tier='I' (independent). Used by privacy/compliance survey for SOC2/HIPAA/ISO/GDPR verification — independent override over vendor self-report.

perEntryFields.format: One of formatTaxonomy keys (default static_html_table). Drives adapter selection.
perEntryFields.extractor: One of extractors keys (default inferred from format).
perEntryFields.fallbacks: Ordered cascade [{format, urlPattern?}]. Walked on primary failure before gaps[].
perEntryFields.tierOverride: Domain-tier override for WebSearch results (string I|S|C).
perEntryFields.imageOCRPatterns: Vendor-only regex strings; URL match triggers scripts/extract-images.py.
perEntryFields.lastVerifiedDate: ISO date URL last verified reachable.
perEntryFields.publishes: Array of bench keys this leaderboard publishes. Two shapes accepted (P10.4 reform): legacy string list ['swePro','sweV',...] OR object list [{key:'swePro',priority:'primary'},...]. Priority drives Phase 3 cascade order (primary → secondary → tertiary → WebSearch fallback). scripts/lib/whitelist.py normalizes both shapes.

_schema._benchKeyNotes: cfElo stores RAW Codeforces ELO (range 0-3500); webDevElo stores RAW LMArena WebDev Arena Elo (range 950-1300 typical, allowed up to 1500); every other bench key stores 0-100 percentage. compositeScore() in assets/js/data.js normalizes cfElo and webDevElo via core.js normalizeBenchScore() (linear map to 0-100) before weighting. audit-data-coherence.py allows cfElo cells in [0, 3500] and webDevElo cells in [0, 1500]. 2026-07-25: sciCode / ifBench / aaLcr / tau3 / deepSwe all store 0-100 percentages and need no normalization entry.
_schema.benchKeysUsage: Universe of bench keys = coreBenchKeys ∪ leaderboards[].publishes[]. New leaderboards extending publishes[] auto-extend the universe. Frontend BENCH_KEYS in assets/js/core.js is regenerated from coreBenchKeys ∪ benchCategories by scripts/gen-bench-keys.py — run it after editing either. 2026-07-25 retune: added sciCode, ifBench, aaLcr, tau3, deepSwe (the first four align our atomic layer with AA Intelligence Index v4.0, whose components we previously excluded as 'already counted atomically' while tracking only half of them; deepSwe is the contamination-free frontier discriminator). Removed six zero-data vendor-composite keys. Retired nl2Repo / webDevElo / lbCoding to zero weight.

newReleaseProbe.purpose: WebSearch-based new-release net for Phase 0. Catches a vendor's new model even when its lineup docs page is broken (404/SPA/redirect). Model-agnostic: the agent expands each template per vendor at runtime, NEVER hardcodes a model name.
newReleaseProbe.familyHintSource: Derive {familyHint} from the vendor's existing model family in idea_context.currentIds — strip the trailing version token from the most-recent id for that vendor (e.g. currentIds 'claude-opus-4-7' → familyHint 'Claude Opus 4'; 'gpt-5-4' → 'GPT-5'; 'qwen3-6' → 'Qwen3'). If the vendor has no currentIds entry, use {vendorName} alone. Do NOT invent a specific next-version number.
newReleaseProbe.yearWindow: Use the agent's current calendar year and the prior year as {year} (two probes per template when crossing a year boundary).
newReleaseProbe.emit: For every model name surfaced by these searches whose canonical id is NOT in idea_context.currentIds, append to lineupChanges.new[] = { suggestedId, vendor, evidenceUrl, observedVersion, source:'newReleaseProbe' }. A surfaced id already in currentIds is ignored (no-op). Unverifiable single-snippet hits emit gaps[] 'newrelease:<vendor>: unconfirmed' instead of lineupChanges.new.
newReleaseProbe.minEvidence: ≥1 independent (non-vendor) snippet OR the vendor news/blog post confirming the release; vendor-page-only with no corroboration → still emit but tag evidenceConfidence:'single'.

defaultFallbacks.note: Vendor model card on huggingface.co carries announced benches.

aggregator_mirror.description: Independent aggregator mirror of a SPA leaderboard's scores (pricepertoken/llm-stats/vals.ai/benchlm). Real cascade step for spa_full + bot_blocked sources before websearch_snippet.

hf_model_card.description: huggingface.co/<org>/<model> model card — vendor-published benches in the card README. Fallback for bot_blocked vendors.

regex_extract.description: Bench-alias-table run over plain text (cleanup → patterns)

image_ocr.description: Orchestrator-side script + vision read; agent never directly handles images

websearch_snippet.description: Query + tier-assign per result domain (per WEBSEARCH_PRIMARY_DISCIPLINE)

regexLibrary._purpose: SSOT for all extraction patterns. Agent NEVER inlines a regex; references by name only. Patterns audited for ReDoS + Unicode + locale tolerance via scripts/regex-lint.js against scripts/regex-corpus.json. Regex syntax is ECMAScript; embed-here uses JSON-escaped backslashes.
regexLibrary._localeDecimalRule: If captured number contains both '.' and ',': last occurrence is decimal, other is thousands (strip). Only ',': /^\d{1,3},\d{3}(,\d{3})*$/ → thousands form (strip); else decimal (replace ',' with '.'). Handles 87.6, 87,6, 1,234.56, 1.234,56, 1 234,56.

DASH_CLASS.description: 9 Unicode dash variants (hyphen-minus, hyphen, NB-hyphen, figure dash, en/em dash, horizontal bar, minus sign, small/full-width hyphen)

WHITESPACE_CLASS.description: Whitespace incl NBSP, thin-space, narrow-no-break-space, figure-space — BIPM thousands separator coverage

EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER.description: Recognized non-numeric cells; row matched but value emitted as null

LATIN_DIGITS.description: Latin digits only; non-Latin numerals (Arabic-Indic/Thai/Devanagari) get C-tier WebSearch fallback

bench_score_labeled.description: Bench name + score in same span. Bounded paren content (max 40c), Unicode dashes, decimal locale-tolerant, optional unit, version suffix v1..v99. Most-common pattern.

bench_score_table_row.description: HTML table row; bounded inner cell count (1-30) and cell length (0-200c). Pass-2 row split, pass-3 cell value walk paired with row-first cell as model anchor.

bench_score_uncertainty.description: '87.6 ± 0.3' or '87.6±0.3'. Symmetric uncertainty; primary value isolated, sigma captured.

bench_score_range.description: '85-90' → max captured; agent picks max for ranges, logs delta to gaps[].

bench_score_normalized_0_1.description: '0.876' → multiply ×100. Only when bench typically reports 0-100 per benchSchema hint; guard against confidence-interval false positives. ELO GUARD (4.5): NEVER apply to a raw-Elo bench (cfElo / webDevElo / lmArenaElo) — those report 0-3500 / ~900-1700, never 0-1 normalized, so a '0.xx' near an Elo cell is a CI/footnote, not the score.

pricing_per_million.description: '$5.00 / 1M tokens', '$0.20/M'. Optional space, optional '1' prefix, plural-tolerant.

pricing_input_output_pair.description: '$3 in / $15 out'. Direction labels; optional second '$'.

pricing_subscription_tier.description: 'Pro tier $20/mo'. Unicode-safe casing; common tier names.

vendor_lineup_active_id.description: Model id under 'active models' / 'current' heading. Code-fenced ids; semver-like; min 2 letters at start (rejects 'v1.0' false-positives) and tolerates trailing alpha suffix like '-pro' / '-mini'.

next_image_proxy_url.description: Next.js _next/image proxy URL — URL-decode in post-process.

markdown_table_row.description: Pipe-separated row; bounded cell count (1-30) and cell length (1-200c). Post-process rejects separator rows matching ^\|[\s\-:]+\|.

meta_description_score.description: <meta name=description content=...> — then run bench_score_labeled over content. Catches SPA top-N scores in head.

jsonld_score_field.description: <script type=application/ld+json>...</script> — JSON-parse and walk for aggregateRating, score, value, mainEntity.score numeric fields.

perModelExpansion.description: Cascade discovery: when leaderboard aggregate has sparse cells for a model, agent attempts perModelUrlTemplate using slugVariations against model.id. Each {id} in a variation is replaced with the model.id. {family} = model.id with version suffix stripped (e.g., grok-3-mini → grok). {N} = numeric major version. {YYMMDD} = released-date condensed. {variant} = vendor-specific subfamily token (pro/flash/lite).

fields.perModelUrlTemplate: URL with {slug} placeholder for per-model page
fields.perModelFormat: Format key for per-model page (may differ from leaderboard format)
fields.slugVariations: Ordered array of slug variants to try; first 200 wins
fields.postUrlPattern: Vendor blog post URL pattern; agent uses postSlugVariations

cascadeOrder: 2. perModelUrlTemplate × slugVariations (NEW; for entries that have one)

contracts._purpose: SSOT for every threshold, retry count, and pass/fail criterion the skill + agent + scripts share. SKILL.md/agent.md reference this block rather than mirroring values; merge.py + audit-* scripts fetch via scripts/lib/whitelist.py contracts().

notApplicableRules._retired: N/A retired 2026-05-26 — every (model, bench) cell is FILLED or GAP; the agent emits no notApplicable and gap-gen turns unmeasured cells into gaps (freshness-skip only).

benchAliases._purpose: Canonical bench-key ↔ human-name mapping. Agent extraction maps scraped names back to canonical keys via this table — replaces the hardcoded EXTRACTION_DISCIPLINE row 5 table.

huggingfaceExtraction._purpose: HF model card README scraping protocol — Phase 2 PER_MODEL_URL_EXPANSION priority chain
fetchOrder: 1. hfApi: GET /api/models/{org}/{slug} → JSON: {modelId, lastModified, downloads, likes, tags, library_name}
2. hfReadme: GET /<org>/<slug>/raw/main/README.md → markdown → bench table extraction
3. hfModelCard: HTML fallback if README absent or empty

_schema._recognizedNotTrackedNote: 4.5/2026-05-29 — `tau3` (tau-bench v3) is in benchAliases + the confusable Elo/tau family for MISFILE DETECTION ONLY (so a tau3 value is never silently filed as tau2). It is deliberately NEITHER core NOR emerging: promoting it to a tracked, scored bench requires a frontend PR (assets/js/core.js BENCH_KEYS + i18n tr/en labels), which is out of scope for the data pipeline. Until tau-bench v3 has real cross-model adoption, a genuine tau3 observation is recognized-but-not-stored; the agent emits a discoveries.benchmarks[] candidate instead.
_schema._deprecatedBenchKeysNote: FAZ 5.B/C 2026-05-09 split bench universe from 26 → 10 core keys. These 16 legacy keys still hold values in data/models.json (preserved for historical accuracy) but are no longer refreshed by gather agents and not surfaced in priorityCells. Audit accepts them as 'deprecated' rather than 'unknown'. Front-end may render them in a 'historical' section or hide entirely. 2026-07-25: the six vendor-composite keys llmStatsIdx / vellumRank / hfOpenAvg / kluRank / benchlmIdx / lmArenaElo joined this list. They held 0, 0, 0, 0, 3 and 5 values across 112 models while sitting in the consensus preset's ten-entry vendorCompositeView, so the coverage denominator was 10 against an achievable maximum of ~4 — every model took a systematic shrinkage penalty and aaOmni presence alone swung the ranking. Their stray cells were deleted from models.json + sources.json in the same pass, so nothing is orphaned.

normalization._purpose: Per-bench normalize to [0,100] composite scale. Loaded by assets/js/core.js normalizeBenchScore() with backward-compat fallback to hardcoded literals. Adding a new ELO-scale bench = data PR only.

aaOmni._note: AA Omniscience: lower is better; inverted so higher composite = better

confidence._purpose: Parameters for cellConfidence() haircut in assets/js/data.js. Each cell's contribution to composite scales by verif * trust * (1 - penalty).
confidence._penaltyNote: delta < CONTRADICTION_WARN_PP → 0 penalty; delta >= CONTRADICTION_WARN_PP → 0.15; delta >= CONTRADICTION_BLOCK_PP → 0.40
confidence._fallbackTrustNote: Used when max trustScore = 0 (e.g., source has no trustScore field yet)
confidence._pseudoSourcesNote: These source names are non-evidentiary (extraction hints, not real provenance). Excluded from urls.size + trustScore aggregation.

benchKind._purpose: Classify each bench key. Atomic = single-test methodology, single publisher. VendorComposite = aggregate-of-benches by external publisher (their own weighting). AICoderMap composite uses ONLY atomic; vendor composites surface in cross-validation panel.
benchKind._rule: If bench X's score is a function of OTHER benches' scores (by an external publisher's weighting), it's vendorComposite. Single-bench aggregates like Elo (head-to-head matches within ONE eval) stay atomic.

vendorComposites._purpose: Metadata for vendor-aggregated composite benches. Used by UI cross-validation panel + 'AA says X' tooltips. NOT included in AICoderMap composite weighting (would cause double-counting since componentBenches are already weighted atomically).

aaIdx.label: AA Intelligence Index
aaIdx._componentNote: AA Intelligence Index v4.1 aggregates nine evaluations: GDPval-AA v2, tau3-Banking, Terminal-Bench v2.1, SciCode, Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, CritPt, AA-Omniscience and AA-LCR. componentBenches lists the seven we track atomically; GDPval-AA (occupational rather than coding) and CritPt (physics) are deliberately untracked. Verified 2026-07-25. NOTE: ifBench is NOT a v4.1 component — it was one in v4.0 and we track it on its own merit (AA-published, broad coverage, and instruction adherence is what breaks long agent loops), not as index alignment.

aaCoding.label: AA Coding Index
aaCoding._componentNote: Equal-weighted Terminal-Bench v2.1 + SciCode; 28 of 198 AA-tracked models. Verified 2026-07-25 at artificialanalysis.ai/models/capabilities/coding.

aaAgentic.label: AA Agentic Index
aaAgentic._componentNote: Equal-weighted GDPval-AA v2 + tau3-Banking; 28 of 171 AA-tracked models. Only tau3 is tracked atomically (GDPval-AA is occupational, not coding). Verified 2026-07-25 at artificialanalysis.ai/models/capabilities/agentic.

composite._purpose: Policy parameters for AICoderMap composite score formula.
composite._coverageShrinkageNote: composite = raw * (coverage ^ (1/exponent)). 2 = sqrt (current behavior). >2 = gentler penalty for low coverage. 1 = linear. 0 = no penalty.

rankGate._note: Leaderboard rank gate (2026-06-07, coverage-aware missing-required 2026-07-16). A model is DEMOTED out of the main ranking into a contiguous 'Limited Coverage' band at the bottom (never hidden) when EITHER: (a) it is missing a requiredBenches AND its overall preset-weighted coverage is below missingRequiredCoverageFloor, OR (b) its coverage alone is below coverageFloor (regardless of which benches are missing). Primary mechanism behind the EB anomaly fix: EB shrinkage toward the global median otherwise lets a model with a few extreme cells but a missing heaviest-weighted required bench (e.g. swePro in swe-focused) float into the top — that risk is real only when the model is ALSO sparse overall (few real cells backing those extreme scores). A well-covered model (coverage >= missingRequiredCoverageFloor) missing just one required bench is not gamed data — e.g. kimi-k2-7-code at 69% coverage under 'balanced', missing only swePro because Moonshot genuinely never published it (confirmed via primary source, 2026-07-16) — so it competes on its EB-shrunk score instead of being hidden in the bottom band. demoteMissingRequired:true uses the SAME requiredBenches list presetTiersFor reads (SSOT). enabled:false → no gate (anomaly sweep uses this to surface the gated population). Independent of the eb block.

eb._note: Empirical-Bayes leaderboard point score (compositeScoreImputed + compositeUncertainty). score = (W_obs*observedMean + priorWeight*globalMedianMean)/(W_obs+priorWeight) - sigmaPenaltyMax*max(0,(confThreshold-confidence)/confThreshold)^2, confidence = observedWeight/activeWeight. Missing benches shrink toward the conservative global-median baseline (not zeroed, not full-marks); the penalty is zero until confidence drops below confThreshold so a model missing a couple of benches is not docked, while genuinely sparse models are. priorWeight raised 25→30 on 2026-06-07 as a hygiene nudge alongside the rankGate (slightly stronger shrink toward the baseline for sparse profiles); confThreshold/sigmaPenaltyMax unchanged. enabled:false reverts to raw*coverage^(1/exponent).

imputation._disabledNote: Enabled 2026-05-18. effectiveScore() dispatches to compositeScoreImputed which fills missing imputable benches with peer-tier median (≥3 peers, normalized via _schema.normalization). Imputed cells weighted at imputedConfidenceFactor (0.5); total imputed share capped at maxImputedWeightShare (0.30).

composite._minCoverageDisplayNote: Models below this fraction of preset coverage get 'limited data' UI badge.

uncertainty._purpose: LMArena-inspired CI-overlap rank bands. Composite carries an EPISTEMIC uncertainty (sigma) propagated from per-cell evidence quality (cellConfidence + contradiction spread + imputation). rankBands() assigns rank = 1 + #models whose lower bound exceeds this model's upper bound, so models within noise share a band. NOT a frequentist 95% CI — labelled 'uncertainty range'; a numeric band is shown only when >= minSourcesForCI distinct sources back the model (else range-only).
uncertainty._sigmaMaxNote: Max per-cell SD (0-100 scale) at cellConfidence=0; sigma_conf = sigmaMax * (1 - cellConfidence). 10 keeps well-sourced cells (conf~0.5) near +/-5 and high-conf cells tight, rather than over-stating uncertainty from the trustScore posterior plateau.
uncertainty._contraDivisorNote: sigma_contra = contradictionDelta / contraDivisor (pp spread treated as ~2 SD range).
uncertainty._imputeSigmaNote: Floor SD applied to imputed (peer-median) cells — they are estimates, never observations.
uncertainty._sparsityAlphaNote: Extra band width from missing coverage: sigma_sparsity = score * sparsityAlpha * (1 - coverage).
uncertainty._bandMultNote: Band half-width = bandMult * sigma_composite. 1 = +/- 1 sigma. Higher = wider (more conservative) bands.
uncertainty._minSourcesForCINote: Models with fewer distinct sources on the majority of covered cells show a single-source flag instead of a numeric band (pitfall: no fabricated CI from one source).

benchRanges._purpose: Per-bench plausibility bands consumed by audit-data-coherence.py. hardMin/hardMax = scale-corruption guard: a value outside is wrong-scale garbage that would distort the 0-100 composite → HARD BLOCK. softMin/softMax = plausibility band: a value inside the hard band but outside the soft band is unusual-but-possible → advisory WARN (re-verify, never reject — a genuine outlier/breakthrough stays). Benches not listed default to a 0-100 percentage (hard 0-100, no soft flag).

presets._purpose: Data-driven preset definitions. assets/js/core.js PRESETS literal loads from here with backward-compat fallback. 'consensus' uses the vendor composite mean rather than atomic weighting. Per-preset tiered bench classification (required/critical/imputable) drives missing-data UI policy in data.js + render-card.js. CONTRACT (enforced by audit-data-coherence.py): atomicWeights may contain ONLY keys in benchKind.atomic and must sum to exactly 100 — a vendor-composite key placed here is silently discarded by compositeScore().

consensus.description: Mean of the four Artificial Analysis composites (Intelligence, Coding, Agentic, Omniscience). Coverage-penalized: a model carrying one of the four cannot outrank a model carrying all four. Narrowed from ten entries on 2026-07-25 — six of the ten publishers had 0-5 values across 112 models, so the denominator punished every model for data that was never collectable.

balanced.description: Coding-leaning portfolio across SWE coding, multi-turn agentic work and the reasoning frontier.
balanced._atomicNote: Retuned 2026-07-25, atomic-only. The previous block spent 9 of its 100 points on aaCoding/aaAgentic/aaIdx, which compositeScore() discards as vendor composites — the lens actually ran at 91. IFBench added because instruction-following failure is what breaks long agent loops.

swe-focused.description: Anchored on SWE-bench Pro + Terminal-Bench 2.1 + LiveCodeBench, extended 2026-07-25 with DeepSWE (contamination-free original tasks, one shared harness) and SciCode (Artificial Analysis' scientific-coding eval, half of AA's own Coding Index). Terminal-Bench Hard joins the lens it was missing from despite 72% coverage.
swe-focused._atomicNote: Retuned 2026-07-25. cfElo dropped from 9 to 0: puzzle-style competitive programming is a weak proxy for repository work and 0 of its 22 filled cells were backed by a primary publisher. sweMulti cut 14 to 6 and sweV 9 to 6 (OpenAI retired SWE-bench Verified in February 2026 over contamination; ranks 6-10 sit inside 0.4pp). The freed weight went to tbHard, sciCode and deepSwe, which discriminate at the frontier.

agentic-focused.description: Weights tau2-Bench (multi-turn reliability), Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Hard, MCP-Atlas, tau3-Banking and IFBench.
agentic-focused._atomicNote: Retuned 2026-07-25, atomic-only (aaAgentic's 9 points were discarded weight). tau3-Banking enters as a tracked bench: it is one of the two components of AA's Agentic Index, so leaving it out meant our cross-validation panel compared against a composite we could not see inside. tbHard raised 8 to 12 on 72% coverage and 80% primary sourcing.

reasoning-focused.description: Anchored on Humanity's Last Exam plus GPQA Diamond, AIME 2026, MMLU-Pro and the long-context pair AA-LCR + MRCR.
reasoning-focused._atomicNote: Retuned 2026-07-25, atomic-only — aaOmni (4) and aaIdx (6) were discarded weight, so this lens ran at 90. AA-LCR added at 8: long-context reasoning is the reasoning axis that actually governs repository-scale work, and AA publishes it broadly. ARC-AGI-3 was evaluated and rejected — every frontier model scores under 1%, so it cannot discriminate yet.

benchmark-only.description: Spreads weight across every atomic bench that still earns weight, for the raw scientific surface. The three retired keys (nl2Repo, webDevElo, lbCoding) render on cards but score nothing.
benchmark-only._atomicNote: Retuned 2026-07-25, atomic-only (aaIdx/aaCoding/aaAgentic held 8 points of discarded weight). Now genuinely covers every weighted atomic key — the previous block claimed full coverage while omitting bfcl entirely.

benchVerificationStrict._purpose: Per-bench stricter verification thresholds for cells that have historically attracted hallucinated provenance. Audit's MX6 rule and agent's per-cell verification both consult this map.

tau2.rationale: tau2 scores require an actual leaderboard entry; vendor self-reports without a public leaderboard backing are quarantine candidates.

swePro.rationale: Scale SEAL is the gold harness. Self-reports (mini-swe-agent / openhands / agentless) are acceptable but the scaffold MUST be in the source.note so cross-harness comparisons stay honest.

lcb.rationale: LCB has multiple versions (v5/v6); contradictions across versions are common and require ≥2 sources to disambiguate.

cfElo.rationale: Codeforces Elo is a raw score in the 1500-3500 range and feeds the composite at full weight via normalization; a single source is too easy to misfile (see 4.3 opus-4-7.cfElo). Require 2 distinct independent sources (5.3).

benchVerificationStrict._coreSingleSourceHardBlockNote: 5.3 — when true, MX5 escalates from WARN to merge-blocking FAILURE for any core-bench cell with <2 distinct source URLs (single-source core values flow into the composite at full weight). Kept false while the current snapshot still carries ~93 grandfathered single-source core cells; the next full refresh-all closes that gap (each gather adds a 2nd source), after which flip this to true to enforce. The audit MECHANISM is always present and unit-testable regardless of the flag.

mcpA.rationale: Audit 2026-07-25: 0 of 23 filled mcpA cells carried a Scale-domain source — every value came from aggregators republishing it. Scale re-scored the whole leaderboard in April 2026 (judge upgrade, 100 tool-call budget replacing the 20-turn limit), so republished pre-April numbers are silently stale.

deepSwe.rationale: DeepSWE's value is that every model runs the SAME mini-swe-agent harness on tasks written from scratch. A vendor self-report under a different scaffold is not comparable and must not be filed here.

sciCode.rationale: Artificial Analysis runs this evaluation itself under one harness; a vendor-reported number measures a different setup and is corroboration only.

ifBench.rationale: Artificial Analysis runs IFBench itself under one harness. It is not an Intelligence Index v4.1 component, so a vendor-reported number has no index cross-check behind it and is corroboration only.

aaLcr.rationale: Artificial Analysis runs this evaluation itself under one harness; a vendor-reported number measures a different setup and is corroboration only.

tau3.rationale: Artificial Analysis runs this evaluation itself under one harness; a vendor-reported number measures a different setup and is corroboration only.

dataResidency.definition: ISO-2 country/region codes where API processes data; 'global' = any region

soc2.definition: true=SOC2 Type II audited (vendor or audit registry confirmed); false=not audited; null=unverified

gdpr.definition: true=GDPR compliant (DPA available, EU residency or SCCs); false=not compliant; null=unverified

apiLogging.definition: not_logged=zero retention; opt_out=user can disable; default_off=off by default; default_on=on by default

benchTypes._purpose: G5 (2026-07-15): contamination-risk taxonomy per bench. rotating = pool refreshes continuously (live votes / re-runs / monthly rotation); temporal = tasks filtered by date cutoff (post-training-cutoff only); static = frozen split, contamination risk grows with age (2026 SWE-bench Verified controversy). Surfaced in the site glossary; informs preset weight retunes (e.g. sweV demotion).

unknownVendorProbe._purpose: Phase 0 unknown-vendor/unknown-model discovery sub-probe SSOT (2026-07-16). Concrete, data-driven source list so the agent scans a repeatable set every full cycle instead of ad-hoc web search alone -- procedure stays in agent.md, URLs live here per the project's data-vs-procedure invariant.

unknownVendorProbe.procedure: For each huggingfaceListings[].url: fetch, extract every repo id (org/model). For each org not already a key in sourcesWhitelist.vendors AND not a known non-vendor (dataset host, quantizer/GGUF-repacker, community finetuner with no distinct model family), and for each model whose family looks coding-relevant (name/README mentions code/SWE-bench/coding, or the org is already known to publish coding models), emit a discoveries.vendors[] candidate per the existing schema shape ({id, observedAt, modelCount, latestRelease, suggestedTier}). Cross-check the same org/model name against aggregatorIndexes[] for corroboration -- 2 distinct signals (e.g. HF trending + OpenRouter newest) raises evidenceConfidence. Never auto-add; discoveries.vendors[] stays a human-reviewed queue (scripts/promote-discovery.py).

_schema._retiredBenchKeysNote: 2026-07-25: tracked and rendered for historical continuity but carry ZERO weight in every preset. nl2Repo (19/112 models, 0% of cells backed by a primary publisher), webDevElo (7/112, 0%) and lbCoding (11/112) never reached the coverage or provenance bar to move a composite honestly. Distinct from deprecatedBenchKeys: those keys are gone from BENCH_KEYS entirely, these still render on a model card.

lowConfidenceUrls._purpose: Root-listing URLs (whole-leaderboard pages) prone to cross-row misattribution. Agent fetch returns rendered HTML with all models × all benchmarks, but extracting a specific (modelId, benchKey) cell from such a listing is error-prone. trustScore is multiplied by trustPenaltyMultiplier (default 0.5) when a citation's URL matches one of these patterns. Specific bench-path URLs (e.g. https://llm-stats.com/benchmarks/livecodebench) are NOT penalized — they unambiguously identify the bench.
